title: DNS over QUIC RFC 9250 Stream Lifecycle Verification
verification_method: Focused loopback tests, requirement-home trace tests, SpecTrace JSON validation, and diff hygiene for the DoQ query/response stream lifecycle.
scope: This verification covers minimal DoQ query/response transactions: separate bidirectional streams per query, same-stream response writes, client and server write FIN behavior, and concurrent queries over one persistent connection. It does not verify cancellation/reset policy, padding, AXFR/IXFR, 0-RTT, Retry/address validation, or external interop.
preconditions: The DoQ foundation package and message codec exist.
The local managed QUIC loopback support is available for stream-level tests.
expected_result: The focused DoQ stream lifecycle tests pass, core SpecTrace validation accepts the RFC 9250 artifacts, and no whitespace hygiene issues are introduced.
status_summary: The DoQ adapter now proves minimal query/response stream mapping over real QUIC streams. Remaining RFC 9250 cancellation, padding, zone transfer, 0-RTT, address validation, and interop behavior remains future work.
